title: Fish Folk: Jumpy
description: Tactical 2D pixel-art shooter for 2-4 players, local or online, where fish brawl with weapons on small arenas. Built on the fishfolk Bones meta-engine with a deterministic ECS and rollback netcode, with a web demo.
licence_note: Dual licence covers source code; art and audio have their own terms.

title: Fish Folk: Punchy
description: 2.5D side-scrolling beat 'em up with fish characters, combo attacks and enemy waves. Data-driven fighters and levels loaded from YAML assets; JS scripting experiments.

title: Bones (Fish Folk meta-engine)
description: A framework for moddable multiplayer 2D games, rendered by Bevy but with its own deterministic, snapshot-able ECS, schema-based assets and scripting. Extracted from Jumpy.

title: Digital Extinction
description: Free open-source 3D real-time strategy game (humans vs AI) with a lobby server and multiplayer connector. Archived in 2024; good reference for RTS plumbing in Bevy.
attribution: Digital Extinction contributors (Martin Indra et al.)
licence_note: AGPL-3.0 copyleft: link only, never copy code into non-AGPL work. Repo archived.

title: Foxtrot
description: 3D reference project and tech demo by Jan Hohenheim: first-person exploration with physics, dialogue, NPC navigation and TrenchBroom-authored levels, running natively and on the web.

title: bevy_new_2d template
description: TheBevyFlock's official-community template for new 2D Bevy games (formerly bevy_quickstart), with menus, audio, dev tools, asset loading and itch.io CI/CD. Its design doc explains the code patterns.

title: Bevy example: breakout
description: Bevy's own small Breakout clone: paddle, ball, bricks, scoreboard and collision sounds in one file. Lives in examples/showcase on main (was examples/games).

title: Bevy example: alien_cake_addict
description: Official 3D example game: move on a grid board to eat cakes before they vanish; shows game states, scene loading and a game-over screen. In examples/showcase on main.

title: Unofficial Bevy Cheat Book
description: Community reference book of practical Bevy recipes and explanations (ECS, schedules, states, input, assets, cameras, windows). Reference, not a game; may lag the latest Bevy.
licence_note: Code snippets MIT-0; prose CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial). Link only.

title: Avian physics (formerly bevy_xpbd)
description: ECS-native 2D and 3D physics engine for Bevy with many runnable demos (character controllers, joints, ragdolls, sensors). The usual physics choice in recent jam games.
patterns: rigid bodies and colliders as components

title: Blenvy
description: Blender add-on plus Bevy crates that let you author Bevy components and blueprint prefabs inside Blender and export them via glTF, with hot reload. Alpha.

title: space_editor
description: A prefab/scene editor for Bevy with gizmos, component editing, nested prefabs and edit/play mode switching; supports bevy_xpbd_3d.

title: Tiny Glade (reference only)
description: Commercial cozy castle-building toy by Pounce Light, widely reported to run on a modified Bevy (ECS) with a custom renderer and heavy procedural geometry. Closed source; useful as a quality bar, not code.
licence_note: Engine details come from secondary sources, not an official write-up.

title: Thetawave
description: Physics-based roguelite space shooter with procedurally generated levels, multiple characters, power-ups and local co-op; data-driven via RON files.

title: Kataster
description: Minimal single-screen Asteroids-style space shooter aimed at Bevy beginners, kept up to date with recent Bevy releases.

title: bevy_game_template (NiklasEi)
description: Long-running Bevy game template with CI/CD for web, Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS and Android, a loading state and menu.

title: Oicana
description: Small tower-defence game with puzzle elements by Niklas Eicker.
licence_note: No licence file in repo: treat as all rights reserved.

title: Taipo
description: Typing tower-defence game for practising Japanese kana/kanji (with an English mode): type words to build and fire towers. Uses Tiled maps.

title: Build A Better Buddy
description: Cute auto-battler made by Bevy's creator Carter Anderson for Bevy Jam #1.

title: Warlock's Gambit
description: 3D card/puzzle game where you cheat at cards with spells; Team Plover's Bevy Jam #1 entry.

title: Bevy Jam Simulator
description: Incremental/idle game about entering a Bevy Jam: type to write code, spawn entities, buy upgrades, manage technical debt. 2nd place, Bevy Jam #4.
licence_note: Music is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; splash image belongs to the Bevy Foundation.

title: Simon Says (Bevy Jam #5 winner)
description: 3D puzzle game where you program a looping sequence of moves; winner of Bevy Jam #5 (theme 'cycles'). Author's blog covers the cyclic puzzle design.

title: Live. Die. Repeat.
description: Top-down 2D action/stealth game where each death leaves a ghost replaying your previous run; 2nd place Bevy Jam #5. Based on the Bevy quickstart template.
attribution: 4D4XFUN team (4D4XFUN, mpwoz, Emily, toast and others)

title: Epicycles (Ptolemy's Epicycles)
description: Puzzle game about rotating interlocking cycles to move objects into place; 3rd place Bevy Jam #5.
licence_note: No licence file: all rights reserved by default.

title: Blobo Party!
description: Musical roguelike deckbuilder where cards fire on the beat; 4th place Bevy Jam #5.

title: A Fistful of Boomerangs (Bevy Jam #6 winner)
description: Winner of Bevy Jam #6 (theme 'chain reaction'): a top-down action game built around boomerangs.
licence_note: No licence file found in repo.

title: Chainboom
description: 3D first-person shooter where zombies explode in chain reactions; 3rd place Bevy Jam #6, by Jan Hohenheim, Jondolf (Avian author), Mafii and PlsgiveMango. Built on Foxtrot's stack.

title: Abiogenesis
description: Particle-life sandbox: tweak an attraction/repulsion matrix and build organisms that compete for mass; 4th overall and 1st in execution, Bevy Jam #6. Touch and mouse controls.

title: Flux Pursuit
description: Bevy Jam #6 entry (5th place) by Pyrious, jayclees and Median.

title: ¿Quién es el MechaBurro?
description: 3D twin-stick shooter for single player or local multiplayer, made in a week for Bevy Jam #1.

title: ascii-bomb-ecs
description: ASCII-styled Bomberman clone with several modes and a web build with mobile touch controls.
licence_note: Licence covers code only; images and other assets excluded.

title: Extreme Bevy
description: Low-latency peer-to-peer browser shooter that is the end result of Johan Helsing's tutorial series on GGRS rollback and Matchbox WebRTC networking.
licence_note: Sprites are not covered by CC0 (tribute to Extreme Violence).

title: lightyear (netcode library + examples)
description: Networking library for Bevy multiplayer: client prediction, server reconciliation, interpolation, input delay, rooms; ships many example games.

title: vx_bevy
description: Minecraft-like voxel engine prototype: greedy-meshed chunks generated and meshed on async task pools. No longer updated past 0.14.

title: Bevy Snake tutorial (Marcus Buffett)
description: Step-by-step Snake tutorial for Bevy 0.7: grid positions, fixed-timestep movement, food spawning, tail growth and game over. Old API, but the structure still teaches.
licence_note: Neither repo nor post states a licence.

title: Combine Racers
description: 2.5D side-scrolling trick racer: do tricks in the air to gain speed. Bevy Jam #2 entry, maintained to 0.14.

title: sokoban-rs
description: Sokoban with a built-in solver, level collections and auto-moving player; kept current with Bevy.

title: Lost Oppai
description: Cozy 2D game with procedural world generation and branching NPC dialogue written in Yarn Spinner.
licence_note: MIT applies to content not otherwise licensed; see CREDITS.

title: Rock Run: Rose's Odyssey
description: Old-school 2D platformer for children with math/reading puzzles; levels made in Tiled, CC0 Kenney assets.

title: bevy-tnua
description: Floating character controller for Bevy (works with Avian or Rapier) with jump, crouch, dash and coyote time; demos for 2D and 3D platformers.

title: leafwing-input-manager
description: Stateful input manager mapping keyboard, mouse and gamepad inputs to game actions, with chords, axes and rebinding.

title: bevy_ecs_ldtk
description: Plugin that loads LDtk level-editor projects into Bevy entities and tilemaps; its examples include a platformer.
